name: Managerial Group
description: A group consisting of senior managers and team leaders who are responsible for the strategic direction and decision-making of the organization.

name: Permanent Employees
description: A group consisting of full-time employees with long-term contracts who are a permanent part of the organization.

name: Temporary Hired
description: A group of temporary employees who are hired for short-term assignments or to fulfill seasonal needs.

name: Freelancers
description: A group of self-employed individuals who offer their services to organizations on a contractual basis.

name: Interns
description: A group consisting of students or recent graduates working for the organization temporarily to gain practical experience in their field of study.

name: Consultants
description: A group of external professionals providing expert advice and services to the organization on a short-term or project basis.
